tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals Wednesday in Turin puts Carlos Alcaraz against Daniil Medvedev in the Ivan Lendl Group from 2 p.m., with Flavio Cobolli and Frances Tiafoe chasing a first win after Alexander Zverev qualified by beating Ben Shelton on Tuesday • [SQUASH] PSA China Open continues in Shanghai at the Diamond Squash Center with second-round singles across a 48-player Gold field, while QSF 3 PSA Copper in Doha wraps its run through Nov. 19 • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open day two at Kai Tak keeps HSBC Race to Finals math tight as qualifiers give way to main-draw pressure and key first-round clashes shape Hangzhou berths • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open hits round of 32 at Pictona from 10 a.m. ET, with Humana Championship Court and YouTube streams noon–8 p.m. as John Lucian Goins chases a third straight men's singles title • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat opens the main draw Wednesday at Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex as 200-plus players from 37 nations contest a $300,000 week led by Dang Qiu, Satsuki Odo and Darko Jorgic

newsItems.title: Alcaraz vs Medvedev
newsItems.excerpt: Nitto ATP Finals Wednesday centers on Carlos Alcaraz meeting Daniil Medvedev in Turin, with both 1-0 in the Ivan Lendl Group and a win likely booking a semifinal spot; Flavio Cobolli faces Frances Tiafoe in the nightcap after Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton on Tuesday.

newsItems.title: Shanghai Rolls On
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA China Open advances through round two in Shanghai on a $279,000 Gold week at the Diamond Squash Center, with Sivasangari Subramaniam leading the women's draw and Mostafa Asal among 48 entrants from 14 countries.

newsItems.title: Hong Kong Stakes
newsItems.excerpt: The LI-NING Hong Kong Open's second day at Kai Tak highlights the last Super 500 stop before the HSBC BWF World Tour Finals, with Anders Antonsen installed as men's No. 1 after seed movement and several qualification races still alive across singles and doubles.

newsItems.title: Daytona Round of 32
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA's Proton Daytona Beach Open moves to the round of 32 Wednesday at Pictona, with top seeds chasing 1,000-point Open titles as John Lucian Goins bids for a third straight men's singles crown amid a depleted but wide-open field.
